name: Readme Badges Generator
summary: Generate shields.io badge markdown for GitHub, npm, license, and more.
description: Pick badge presets, set GitHub/npm details and style, preview live badges, and copy markdown for your README. Works offline for generation; badge images load from shields.io when previewed.

faqs.question: Where do badge images come from?
faqs.answer: Markdown points at shields.io URLs. The preview loads those images from the network; the markdown itself is generated locally.

faqs.question: Does the build badge need a real workflow?
faqs.answer: It assumes a ci.yml workflow on the main branch. Rename the path in the markdown if your workflow file differs.

faqs.question: Is my project data uploaded to Forge?
faqs.answer: No. Forge only builds the markdown in your browser.
